entries.description: Continuation of a listing describing 93 acres with woods and camping space hosted by two lesbians. They welcome girl children, non-lesbian women, and prospective members in the future, and maintain a substance-free policy.
entries.raw_text: We welcome: new members/residents (in future), girl children, nonlesbian women. No drugs, alcohol, tobacco. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 93 acres, camping space, woods.
entries.notes: Continued from previous page. Type is Private/Individual Land based on the two-woman rule ('2 lesbians'). Resident count is left blank because the questionnaire list does not explicitly confirm they reside on the land. Recovery/substance-free coded from 'No drugs, alcohol, tobacco.'

entries.description: A women's educational center and retreat on 10 acres of land adjoining several hundred wild acres in Maine, offering intensive residential courses, retreats, apprenticeships, and space for private retreatants and artists in residence.
entries.raw_text: HARDSCRABBLE HILL CENTER Box 130-Castine Rd, Orland, ME 04472 (207)469-7112. From Spring to Fall our intensive residential courses and retreats for women expand the heart, challenge thinking, and offer practical tools and experience. We welcome: new members/residents, workshop participants, workshop guides, internships-apprentices, staff, private retreatants, artists in residence. We welcome all wild women, whatever stage or age on the feminist journey, creating new names as we go. We have: 10 acres of land adjoining several hundred wild, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity in some buildings, camping space, woods, bio-dynamic garden, women living and workin' the land.
entries.notes: Retreat/Gathering Space because its primary purpose is running courses and retreats for visitors. Land location inferred from street address. Non-lesbian women coded under the pre-1986 rule for 'retreats for women' and 'all wild women'. Number of residents is left blank because 'women living and workin' the land' gives no specific number. Only their own 10 acres recorded (excluding 'several hundred wild' adjoining).

entries.land_location_as_stated: surrounded by 100's of acres of unused, undeveloped land at present; woods
entries.description: Private land of 30 acres in Maine hosted by a family of two lesbians and two girl children, offering primitive campsites, hiking trails, and roadside camping for disabled lesbians. They welcome girl children, non-lesbian women, and boys by invitation only, maintaining a substance-free space.
entries.raw_text: LINDA TISDALE/CAROL SHOREBORN RFD 2 Box 3085, Dexter, ME 04930 (207)924-5172. We are a small family of 2 lesbians, 2 girl children, 1 dog, 4 cats, 1 horse (soon to be more). We've cleared trails for hiking, picnics, camping, etc. Our 30 acres is surrounded by 100's of acres of unused, undeveloped land at present. We currently have no housing for other lesbian visitors but we welcome campers. Must be able to hike to campsite carry all needs in and out! Camping available near road for differently abled lesbians. We do not smoke, drink, use drugs. We welcome: girl children (boys by invitation only!), nonlesbian women, dogs. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 2 girl children, 30 acres of land, housing/permanent structures, electricity, well water, outhouse, camping space, woods, women living and workin' on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule. Land address matches RFD mailing address. Residents (4) includes 2 lesbians and 2 girl children living on the land. Boy children coded because accepted '(boys by invitation only!)'. Disabled women coded for 'Camping available near road for differently abled lesbians.' Recovery/substance-free coded for 'We do not smoke, drink, use drugs.'

entries.description: A retreat and healing space on 143 acres in upstate New York, offering primitive camping, swimming ponds, and a sauna in progress, with an eco-friendly policy discouraging chemicals.
entries.raw_text: NORTHWOODS RD 1 Box 156, Alpine, NY 14805. This is additional info to our listing in VI,2. We can offer retreat and healing space mostly in the form of primitive camping - $2 to $5 a day if you can. Our accessibility is unfortunately poor (143 acres almost all uphill.) We'll probably have a visitor kitchen so please bring your own food, the sauna is in progress and both ponds are fine for swimming. Work is welcomed. Chemicals are discouraged.
entries.notes: Retreat/Gathering Space based on offering 'retreat and healing space'. Land address copied from RD mailing address. Environmentalism/eco-friendly coded from 'Chemicals are discouraged.'

entries.land_location_as_stated: Between Harrisburg and Gettysburg.; woods, farmland, pasture
entries.description: A 20-acre homestead and farm in Pennsylvania operated by one woman, with livestock, bees, gardens, and fruit trees, offering short visits in exchange for work, with a strict substance-free rule.
entries.raw_text: ONEIDA FARM RD 5, Dillsburg, PA 17019 (717)432-2157. (Between Harrisburg and Gettysburg.) I am a homesteader/farmer/carpenter on 20 acres with cows (beef and milk), chickens, bees, fruit trees, garden I am not a separatist and cannot accomodate flag-waving, breast-baring sisters. Visits (limited to 2-3 days) require work exchange. No drugs, cigarettes, pets, guns. Visitors are expected to bring own food, etc. Non-lesbian women welcome. I prefer that you telephone so that we get to know each other before we set up a visit. I have a house, barn, electricity, woods, farmland, pasture.
entries.notes: Private/Individual Land owned by one woman ('I am a homesteader/farmer/carpenter on 20 acres'). Land address matches RD mailing address. Resident count is 1. Farming/self-sufficiency coded for farming and livestock. Recovery/substance-free coded for 'No drugs, cigarettes, pets, guns.' Rejection of lesbian separatism noted ('I am not a separatist').

entries.land_location_as_stated: 35 miles north of Baltimore; woods, meadow, stream
entries.description: A women's community and retreat center on 35 acres held in a land trust in Maryland, home to four lesbians, featuring organic gardens, solar heat, and facilities for up to 50 visitors. They welcome all women and children, offering visitor stays and membership.
entries.raw_text: HEATHCOTE WOMENS COMMUNITY 21300 Heathcote Rd, Freeland, MD 21053 (301)343-1070. We are a new wom'ns community/retreat center, 35 miles north of Baltimore. We have/are: 4 lesbians with a feminist perspective, support for political involvement, strong ties with Baltimore wom'ns community, 35 acres of woods, meadow, stream in a land trust, 6 buildings, organic gardens, bees, wood and solar heat, electricity/plumbing, camping and indoor space. We are developing the retreat center (facilities for up to 50) as a business to support the place and members. Local jobs are possible with wom'n landscaping company, wom'ns printing shop. Long and short term commitment. We welcome: visitors, new members, all women of all colours and persuasions, girl and boy children. It's a wonderful place and we want to share it!
entries.notes: Type is Land Trust because the land is explicitly stated to be 'in a land trust'. Land address matches street mailing address. Accepted groups coded under pre-1986 rules for 'all women of all colours and persuasions, girl and boy children'. Environmentalism/eco-friendly coded from 'wood and solar heat'. Farming/self-sufficiency coded from 'organic gardens, bees'. Statement on women of all colours is noted as inclusive rather than centering women of color.

entries.community_name: WE DON'T HAVE A NAME YET
entries.land_location_as_stated: Between Berkeley Springs, WV and Winchester, VA.; woods, farmland
entries.description: Twenty acres in West Virginia with a passive solar shell built by two lesbians, who are musicians welcoming non-competitive musicians and singers, non-lesbian women, children, and men, with a substance-free policy.
entries.raw_text: WE DON'T HAVE A NAME YET c/o Nan and Ruth, PO Box 63, Unger, WV 25447 (304)258-5079. (Between Berkeley Springs, WV and Winchester, VA.) We own 20 acres on which we built a passive solar shell this summer with the help of friends. We have to work away from the land at this point, but one of us is trying to find local work to be able to be more in touch with the land (small-scale farming and a few farm animals are a short-range goal). We are musicians & especially welcome non-competitive musicians and singers. We welcome: non-lesbian wimmin, girl & boy children (parental supervision a must), males, medium to small dogs (females only, please). Bring food to share. No drugs, tobacco, or heavy drinkers. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 20 acres, housing & permanent structures, electricity, camping space, woods, farmland, a male dog (does not get along with other male dogs), wimmin living (full time) and working (part time) on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule. Land city is Unger based on PO box location and regional description; land street/zip left blank. Resident count is 2 ('2 lesbians', 'wimmin living (full time)... on the land'). Gay men and Non-gay men coded from unqualified 'males'. Archives/cultural work coded from active music focus ('We are musicians & especially welcome non-competitive musicians and singers'). Environmentalism/eco-friendly coded from 'built a passive solar shell'. Recovery/substance-free coded from 'No drugs, tobacco, or heavy drinkers.'

entries.land_location_as_stated: hilly southeastern Ohio; woods, pond, farmland
entries.description: An intentional community of 3 to 5 women on 55 acres in southeastern Ohio, offering short stays up to a week for women and children in exchange for help with food and work such as house building, remodeling, and survival chores.
entries.raw_text: MOON RIDGE Rt 1 Box 240, Guysville, OH 45735. We are 3-5 wimmin on 55 acres in hilly southeastern Ohio. We have a house with electricity and a barn and another house under construction. We have dogs, cats, goats, gardens, woods, pond, camping space, farmland, wimmin living and working on and off the land. We welcome wimmin and children to stay up to a week for help with food and work exchange (house re-modeling - house building - daily survival chores).
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative for 3-5 women living collectively on the land. Smaller resident number 3 stored from range '3-5 wimmin'. Land address matches rural route mailing address. Accepted groups coded under pre-1986 rules for 'wimmin and children'.

entries.land_location_as_stated: near Virginia; Located in Northern Minnesota, ten miles from town; woods
entries.description: Private land of over 3 acres with lake access in northern Minnesota, hosted by one lesbian offering country living, privacy, camping, and sauna, welcoming women of all ages for work exchange or cash.
entries.raw_text: WHISPERING WINDS Rt 2 Box 8, Iron, MN 55751 (near Virginia). Country living with privacy for womyn. Located in Northern Minnesota, ten miles from town - access to a small lake. Company of womyn of all ages welcomed. Dogs if restrained. Visits require work exchange and/or cash. I am/have: 1 lesbian, 3+ acres, house/permanent structures, electricity, well, camping space, organic garden, sauna, 2 dogs, cat, woods.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land owned by 1 lesbian. Acreage stored as 3 from '3+ acres'. Land address matches rural route address.
